description:
Compare 2 to 4 boats side by side using Sedna's date-specific pricing.
- boat_ids: list of 2..4 boat ids
- currency: EUR, USD, CNY (default EUR)
- start_date/end_date: optional availability window (YYYY-MM-DD)

Length and beam are optional fleet-supplied facts. Missing values are
omitted rather than returned as zero/null or estimated, and must not make
an otherwise valid yacht unavailable for comparison.
name: compare_boats
